abstract: To identify cis-acting DNA elements involved in the activation of the alpha-fetoprotein gene during differentiation, modified copies of the gene were introduced into murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. The differentiation of the transformants to either parietal or visceral endoderm was accompanied by induction of the exogenous template in a manner qualitatively, but not quantitatively, identical to that of the endogenous alpha-fetoprotein gene.
abstract_ja: 分化の過程でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)遺伝子の活性化に関与するシス作用性DNA配列を同定するため、遺伝子の改変コピーをマウスF9胎児性癌細胞に導入した。形質転換細胞が壁側または臓側内胚葉へ分化すると、導入された遺伝子は内因性のAFP遺伝子と量的には異なるものの質的には同様に誘導された。
